requirements.title: Ephemeral & Cloud-Runner Nodes
requirements.description: A node can be a VM or a cloud macOS/Windows runner provisioned on demand, not only a physical machine. Bridge treats a node as 'any reachable Vrooli install,' so ephemeral capacity composes without special-casing.

validation.notes: Physical, VM, and cloud-runner nodes share one registration/dispatch path; node kind is metadata, not a code branch.
An ephemeral node can join, take a job, and be decommissioned cleanly without leaving fleet state behind.
